about: Fifteen Days v5: Bai's 'What?!' lift, third try, from the trimmed side-glance frame (C20). DRAFTED prompts.

jobs.prompt: Her left hand stays on the table holding the phone. Her other hand is raised to the side of her head and holds that headphone ear cup a little away from her ear. Exactly two arms and two hands, one set of headphones. Keep the drawing, colours, camera, framing and crop exactly as they are; she keeps her face, hair, vest, tattoos and her head turned over her shoulder in profile toward the left. Nobody else anywhere. No letters or numbers.
